name: block-pricing-table
summary: Pricing plans with feature lists, a highlighted plan, and call-to-action slots.
description: A Web block that renders plan cards: name, description, a preformatted price and period, a feature list that announces included and missing features in words, a call-to-action slot, and one highlighted plan with a badge. Built from the Card and Badge primitives and theme tokens; prices and copy arrive through props and it fetches nothing.
use_when: a public site or upgrade page must show plans and prices
the builder asks for a pricing table or plan comparison
one plan should be recommended with a highlight
